description: This file defines an abstract interface for a database and provides an in-memory implementation. It includes methods for creating and retrieving users, sessions, messages, and contexts, serving as the core data layer abstraction for an educational chatbot platform.

classes.name: DatabaseInterface
classes.description: Abstract base class defining the interface for database operations related to users, sessions, messages, and contexts.

classes.name: InMemoryDB
classes.description: Concrete in-memory implementation of the DatabaseInterface, suitable for development and testing without external database dependencies.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_user(self, email: str, password_hash: str, name: Optional[str])
methods.description: Creates a new user with email, password hash, and optional name, returning the user profile dictionary.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_user_by_email(self, email: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a user dictionary by email, or None if not found.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_user_by_id(self, user_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a user dictionary by user ID, or None if not found.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_session(self, user_id: str, title: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Creates a new chat session for a specified user, optionally with a title.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] append_message(self, session_id: str, role: str, content: str)
methods.description: Appends a message with role and content to a specified session.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] list_messages(self, session_id: str)
methods.description: Lists all messages associated with a given session.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] list_sessions(self, user_id: str)
methods.description: Lists all sessions associated with a specified user.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_context(self, user_id: str, data: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Creates a context resource for a user with supplied data.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] list_contexts(self, user_id: str)
methods.description: Lists all context resources associated with a specified user.
